build_anynet_model: build an AnyNet model by passing a params dict with stem_type, block_type, depths, widths, and strides
build_anyhead_module: build an AnyHead classification head with optional conv layer, global avg pool, and linear layer for num_classes
build_resbottleneckblock: build a ResBottleneckBlock with 1x1, 3x3 with SE, 1x1 bottleneck transform and residual skip connection
compute_anynet_complexity: compute the FLOPs and parameter complexity of an AnyNet model using the static complexity method
get_stem_fun: get a stem function class by name such as res_stem_cifar, res_stem_in, or simple_stem_in
